security_review.reason: First SECURITY DEFINER surface implementing the DD-55 hard gate for cross-person DM abuse prevention -- the mechanism the entire open-DM feature's safety posture structurally depends on (dd38-dd86-chat-schema-core's own dm_current_read_allowed calls dm_safety_enabled()/chat_pair_blocked() directly). A fail-open bug here (mis-ordered checks, a one-directional block check, a missing REVOKE, or an accidental grant to app) would let a blocked pair evade the block or let PII about denial reasons leak through the generic exception. Security round must specifically verify: dm_safety_enabled() truly fails closed (COALESCE) when the config row is missing; chat_pair_blocked() checks BOTH directions; assert_dm_allowed()'s raised exception text never varies by deny_reason; and that app/app_worker/readonly have zero grant on any of the four new tables and zero EXECUTE on any of the three new functions after migration.
